title: 2 ## INCIDENCE OF CRIME IN STATES The table below shows the incidence of reported crime in various States, Union Territories and important cities of India during the year 1958 and its variation in comparison with the figures for 1957. The annual incidence of crime per 1,00,000 of population (1951 census) has also been worked out for all of them according to the international standard.
